card.name: Emphasis words after negation
card.fires_on: Small emphasis or connecting words such as 'even', 'either', 'can', 'event' and 'fact' that follow a negation (not, nor, no, n't, never) in argumentative prose.

modes.description: Words like 'can', "n't", or 'either' completing a negative or contrasting statement.
